name: imrotate_bbox
expr: C90 = imrotate(J, 90, 'crop'); C270 = imrotate(J, 270, 'crop'); D30 = imrotate(J, 30); L30 = imrotate(J, 30, 'loose');
comment: MATLAB imrotate bbox + default coverage. 'crop' keeps the INPUT size for 90 deg / 270 deg of a non-square image (3x4, via exact rot90 + centred extraction with direction-dependent half-pixel placement). Default method is 'nearest' (imrotate(J,30) == nearest, sum 86), and the 3-arg form imrotate(A,angle,bbox) treats arg3 as a bbox keyword. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b.
